page.overview:
Who is Free Fall?

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;"

!style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2|Generation 1

Freefall was released in the 1990 series of A Real American Hero toys. ---- Appearance: yellow hair; brown flight suit with green camouflage; dark grey straps on chest, arms, and legs; dark grey gloves and boots

Accessories: green goggled helmet; dark grey air mask with peg for hose; dark grey pouch backpack with gas canisters on sides; dark grey submachine gun with short stock and long magazine and forward grip; standard short, black hose. ---- [http://www.yojoe.com/action/90/freefall.shtml YoJoe.com page]/[http://www.yojoe.com/filecard/90/freefall.shtml Filecard]
